subject: Aligning ML/infra deep-dive — scheduling & agenda options
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@acromed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning ML/infra deep-dive — proposed 60–90m slots and agenda

Hi Julia — thanks again for a constructive discovery call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive with our ML/infra team: 

Recap (2 bullets):
- Main goal: validate latency/cost profile for your batch scoring workload (seq len ~512, peak concurrency ~40 req/s) and confirm deployment pattern (Dedicated vs Private).
- Key risks: data residency questions and integration with your internal KMS for model keys.

Next step: 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (TDX) with our ML infra leads to cover architecture, throughput testing, and rollout plan. Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Tue 25 May, 10:30–12:00 PT
- Wed 26 May, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 27 May, 08:00–09:30 PT

Proposed agenda (flexible — tell me what matters most):
1) 10 min — quick goals & success metrics (your team)
2) 25 min — model/serving requirements (you + Redwood)
3) 25 min — runtime/quantization/throughput discussion (our infra)
4) 15 min — integration and security (KMS, VPC, logs)
5) 15 min — next steps / mutual action plan

I attached a short preread that includes our benchmark summary and a sample mutual action plan. Can you confirm the best slot and which of your engineers (ML/infra) will join so I can loop in the right folks on our side?

Thanks — I’ll hold the three options for now and then send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0121

Attachments: acromed-tdx-preread.pdf (1 page — benchmark summary, proposed agenda)

From: Julia Park <julia@acromed.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning ML/infra deep-dive — proposed 60–90m slots and agenda

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the clear recap. Wed 26 May, 13:00–14:30 PT works for us.

Attendees from AcroMed:
- Julia Park — Data Science lead
- Marcus Lee — ML infra (will drive security/KMS questions)
- procurement@acromed.com — for initial contract/terms flags (might be brief)

Quick ask for agenda: can you include a short section showing comparative throughput numbers for the 8-bit vs fp16 runs (even ballpark) and how caching affects p95? That helps Marcus prep and decide whether to ask for a short test window.

Please send the calendar invite and any pre-call items Marcus should see.

— Julia

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@acromed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning ML/infra deep-dive — proposed 60–90m slots and agenda

Perfect — Wed 26 May, 13:00–14:30 PT is locked for the TDX. Invite and agenda link coming in a minute.

Quick responses to Marcus’ asks:
- We’ll show recent internal numbers comparing int8/4-bit quantized runs vs fp16 (same model family) across A100 and our Dedicated GPU profile. Expect a p95 delta callout and a short note on when KV/prefix cache materially reduces p95 for your expected session lengths.
- We can also propose a 1-hour smoke test window the week after the session if you want to see a short run with a sanitized subset.

Attached preread (acromed-tdx-preread.pdf) contains: benchmark sheet, suggested test harness, and a short mutual-action plan draft. For the call please have Marcus’ SSH/ops contact (or proxy) available for any infra-level Qs.

I’m looping in Ben (solutions lead) and Mina (infra PM) so they can prep slides and the test plan. Ben/Mina — action items below.

Thanks — Sofia

Attachments: acromed-tdx-preread.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Julia Park <julia@acromed.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 19:00:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: AcroMed TDX prep — slides, test plan, roles (Wed 26 May, 13:00 PT)

Ben / Mina — thanks for jumping on this. Wed 26 May, 13:00–14:30 PT is confirmed with AcroMed. Notes and asks: 

1) Objective: demonstrate throughput/latency for their batch scoring profile and align on deployment (Dedicated vs Private). Confirm we have the right benchmark numbers to present.
2) Slides: Ben — 15 min on serving runtime + quantization tradeoffs (include a 1-slide p95 comparison int8 vs fp16). Mina — 20 min on integration, KMS flow, VPC peering constraints, and proposed test harness.
3) Test window: propose a 1-hour smoke run next Thu (3 Jun) using sanitized sample. Need to outline test inputs and required contacts (Marcus Lee).
4) Pre-call reqs: Julia asked specifically for p95/throughput comparisons and cache behavior — include both absolute numbers and percentage deltas where possible.
5) Logistics: I’ll own calendar invite and attendee roster. Ben please prepare a short runbook (2–3 steps) we can send to Marcus ahead of time. Mina please prepare the high-level KMS diagram and list of items that require AcroMed ops involvement.

Links: preread — https://drive.redwood.com/s/acromed-tdx-preread ; calendly slot booked — https://calendly.com/redwood-tdx/60-90min

Attachments to share at call: acromed-tdx-preread.pdf (already shared).

If you want a 20-min internal sync before the call, propose times and I’ll set it.

— Sofia
